segments.text:
She fell for a long time.
Long enough to feel like eternity. Long enough to forget almost everything.
The world of the living grew distant. The demon at the end of her chains could no longer scream.
"Give her back to me."
segments.text_zh:
她坠落了很长时间。
长到像是永恒。长到几乎忘记了一切。
活人的世界越来越远。她锁链尽头的恶魔已经无法尖叫。

segments.text:
There were no last words.
Not even a goodbye.
She chased the shadow that laughed above her daughter's coffin, all the way into a place that should not exist.
segments.text_zh:
没有遗言。
甚至没有道别。
她追逐着在女儿棺材上方大笑的暗影，一直追到了一个不应存在的地方。

segments.text:
The Lord of Hell bent down from the horizon.
"A living mortal, trespassing upon Our domain. And she has caught one of Our little pets."
"We admire thy ability. We admire thy foolishness even more."
"But thou dost not know, perhaps, that Hell hath its own laws."
segments.text_zh: 地狱之主从地平线上俯身。

segments.text:
"No soul that enters this place shall ever depart. They shall suffer here in eternal torment, until time itself doth end."
"This is not a rule We have made. It was written by something far older than We."
"We are merely the executor. A jailer, condemned to walk forever alongside the prisoners."

"Here are nine souls, lingering between life and death. Six are sinners. Three are innocent."
"Find the righteous. Let them live. Succeed, and We shall release them unto Heaven. Thou mayest also take thy daughter's soul."
"Fail, and the innocent shall remain in Hell alongside the guilty."
"As shall thou. As shall thy daughter."

"We have placed upon them masks of virtue and vice. The masks shall make them appear as something they may or may not be. Some sinners wear the face of saints. Some innocents wear the visage of demons."
"As for the sinners—shouldst thou slay the innocent beside thee, We shall grant thee immunity. Thou shalt remain in Hell forever, but thou shalt be spared the punishment."
"Amuse Us. Do not bore Us."

Six sinners. Three innocents.
Beneath the masks, truth lies buried.
Let the judgment begin.
segments.text_zh:
六个罪人。三个无辜者。
面具之下，真相被埋藏。
让审判开始吧。

segments.text: The gates of Hell opened before me.
segments.text_zh: 地狱之门在我面前打开。

segments.text: And there she was. My daughter. Waiting.
segments.text_zh: 她就在那里。我的女儿。在等待。

segments.text: We walked out of the darkness together.
Back to the light. Back home.
I failed. The good souls perished in flames.
segments.text_zh: 我失败了。善良的灵魂在火焰中消逝。
路西法的笑声在永恒中回荡。
我的女儿永远被困在那里。

segments.text: And I... I stay to try again.
segments.text_zh: 而我...我留下来，再次尝试。
